title: Chapter 322
text:
Han Xiao naturally did not want to stay behind. At this time, the operator in the main control room said in surprise, "We have entered the detection range of the model energy detector. The database shows that there are Godora guards in this area. They will appear in at most twenty minutes."

The captain was overjoyed and heaved a sigh of relief. He immediately broadcasted the good news and comforted the passengers.

Seeing this, Han Xiao gave Kerlodd a few instructions and went to support them alone.

…

Cesoly panicked and ran toward the spaceship alone. His subordinates were all captured by Hao Tian and the others. He was the only one who escaped when he saw that the situation was not good. However, he was the only one who escaped.

When he arrived at the place where the scavengers boarded the spaceship, he heard the sound of battle. Cesoly quickly stopped and looked into the distance. He saw that the scavengers who stayed behind were fighting with a group of Supers. He recognized these people. They were Godora's companions, a group of powerful 'natives'.

The battle was at a stalemate. The leader stayed behind and led his subordinates to fight with the players from Dynasty and Temple of God to protect the scavenger spaceship.

The leader of the Gazers was a Psychic. He looked like a birdman with wings and an eagle's head. He specialized in psychic attacks and was the most troublesome enemy for the current players. He had low psychic resistance and could easily be stunned. He alone held the players back.

Cesoly hurriedly ran over and shouted, "Let me go up!"

When the scavengers saw that it was a comrade, they all opened up a path. The leader of the Gazers turned around and grabbed him. "Where are the hostages?" he asked coldly.

"No, no, I was ambushed!"

The leader of the Gazers was furious. They could not catch the Godora person, so this mission had failed. The hostages were their final reward, but they were also gone. Did this not mean that this mission was a waste? They had lost many people, and even the leader of the Boneless Birds, Serpent Braid, was captured.

"That bastard Serpent Braid called us over without investigating the background of this ship. This isn't good business. When Beast Hoof's people come back, we will retreat. You get in there!" The leader of the Gazers kicked Cesoly back into the spaceship.

Soon, another group of scavengers returned. The situation of the Temple of God and Dynasty worsened, and the situation became even more stalemate. The leader of the Gazers ordered them to retreat while fighting. They were about to return to the spaceship and escape from Short Horn Star. The players could do nothing about it and could not stop it at all.

In the distance, a chain of laser cannons shot over and killed several scavengers. Lerden finally arrived at the scene. He looked calm. Although his left mechanical arm had been destroyed, there was still a secret muzzle hidden in his crotch that was shooting high-temperature lasers.

The scavenger hurriedly walked onto the bridge and was about to run back to the spaceship. A green light flashed in Lerden's eyes, and he roared in a low voice. He raised his hand and created many green light curtains that blocked the entrance of the spaceship, preventing the scavenger from entering.

"Don't just stand there. I can't last much longer. Hold them back!" Lerden yelled at the players. He was sweating profusely. The battle with Serpent Braid had cost him a lot of energy. Maintaining the green light curtains required his full concentration. If it were not for the help of the other passengers, he would not have dared to do this.

As long as he could hold them back for a while, these scavengers would not be able to escape once the guards arrived.

"Green Knight!" The leader of the Gazers roared. His psychic power exploded, and a whirlwind appeared around him. The thick psychic power instantly hit Lerden hard.

Lerden groaned. Blood flowed out of his nose, but he held on and did not let the green light curtains disappear.

The scavengers hurriedly attacked the green light curtains. The light curtains trembled like water but did not disappear. Some of the scavengers turned around and charged at Lerden. The light curtains would only disappear if they defeated the Green Knight. The players immediately stopped them.

Light flashed everywhere, and explosions sounded nonstop. The scene was a mess.

On the ship, Cesoly was burning with anxiety. He kept looking at the time, wishing that he could just leave the others behind and escape with a spaceship.

At this moment, Han Xiao arrived. He scanned the situation and immediately understood the situation. He immediately came up with the most violent strategy. As long as he killed the leader of the Gazers, the enemy would be finished.

"Psychic? His level should be a bit lower than Serpent Braid. Typical high attack and low defense. "

Han Xiao's intelligence was quite high, so his mental resistance was not bad. Plus, he was very tanky and liked to deal with enemies with high attack and low defense. The cooldown of Flaming Will was over. Without saying anything, Han Xiao took out his gun and fired a shot.

Boom!

A blazing beam of light shot out from the muzzle. The leader of the Gazers was alerted. He turned around in shock and hurriedly created a psychic shield. However, it shattered instantly. The beam of light swallowed half of his body, burning it black. The pale white psychic light in the leader's eyes disappeared. He screamed and fell to the ground.

This shot had triggered the effect of the talent. When the first shot was fired, there was a 12% -25% chance of causing True Damage.

In Han Xiao's vision, the health of the leader of the Gazers dropped from four-fifths to one-fifth in the blink of an eye!

With such a high damage, the leader of the Gazers was immediately inflicted with Weakened, Heavily Injured, and other negative statuses. Han Xiao seized the opportunity and charged forward at full speed, knocking away the scavengers blocking his way. He rushed into the crowd and directly controlled the leader of the Gazers, who could not resist. This series of actions was completed in a flash. The scavenger leader that the players had been attacking for a long time was taken down.

Although it was a sneak attack, the efficiency was shocking. Lerden's pupils shrank, and his eyes followed Han Xiao's figure closely.

"What a strong guy. Is he also a mercenary?"

The leader of the Gazers and Serpent Braid were similar in strength, but they had different inclinations. Han Xiao's explosive power was most suitable for dealing with enemies with high attack and low defense. In comparison, it was more difficult to deal with enemies like Serpent Braid, who was more of a tank type, and this time, he had triggered True Damage.

Without their leader, the scavengers were in chaos. Cesoly's heart sank. He did not care about anything else and sat in the pilot's seat, about to start the spaceship and escape alone.

Cesoly closed the hatch immediately. Suddenly, he heard the sound of metal tearing. The half-closed hatch was torn open. Han Xiao walked in, picked Cesoly up, and threw him out.

"We meet again." Han Xiao opened his mask and smiled at Cesoly. It was a very friendly smile, but in Cesoly's eyes, it was no different from a wolf, a tiger, or a leopard. The dangerous aura pierced straight into his heart.

"It's you! Don't, don't kill me. I know a lot of things. I know a lot of information … "Cesoly's face was filled with fear. He could not speak coherently and only wanted to beg for mercy.

Bang!

An electromagnetic needle bullet pierced through Cesoly's forehead and blew away half of his head. Blood and flesh splattered all over the floor.

Han Xiao put away his Gaussian sniper rifle and did not even look at Cesoly's corpse. He turned to the people from Temple of God and said, "I'll leave this to you guys."

The remaining scavengers were slaughtered one-sidedly. None of those who boarded the spaceship managed to escape. At this time, the vibration of the spaceship also stopped. Han Xiao looked out the porthole. The scavenger spaceship that had been harassing them in space saw that their companions had all been wiped out and immediately fled.

It was only now that the crisis had truly been resolved.

"It's finally over. Luckily, it was more dangerous than dangerous."

Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief.

Encountering an attacker in space, one moment of carelessness and the spaceship would be destroyed. This small episode made him a little nervous, but it also awakened the nervousness of galactic battles. After staying in Blue Star for too long, Han Xiao's familiarity with galactic battles was gradually returning.

Han Xiao was used to summarizing after a battle. In this attack, he had taken advantage of the player's advantage, split up, and controlled the overall situation. The group of players who suddenly came online was also a pleasant surprise. Overall, he felt that he could give himself a score of eighty-two.

At this time, Han Xiao finally had the time to size up Lerden. Seeing the damaged mechanical prosthetic body, his eyes sparkled.

Mechanical prosthetic body … Hmm, it should be an advanced modification. It also has a transformation function … Out of his professional instinct, Han Xiao subconsciously analyzed the technology.

Although Lerden was quite curious about Han Xiao, he was relatively cold. He stood to the side with an expressionless face and did not have any intention of greeting him.
